note: Pinned tracking and measurement decisions (GA4, GTM, Google tag, links, dashboards). Each entry is a call Matt made; the live setup must keep it. Entries with `check` are verified against live GA4 and GTM by `npm run analytics:audit` (a mismatch is a FAIL: the setup drifted, so fix the setup, not the entry). Entries with `code` name the test or file that holds them. Entries with `manual` say where to look; no read-only API exposes them. Adding an entry is free. Removing one, or changing its check, code or manual, needs a `Tracking-decision: <who, when, why>` commit trailer (scripts/check-tracking-decisions.mjs, commit-msg hook). SEO and AEO calls live in data/seo/decisions.json. Read both before any tracking, SEO, AEO or traffic work.

decisions.why: One page_view per page. The dataLayer push (inline GTM bootstrap on first paint, PageViewTracker once per pathname change) is sent by the GTM tag 'GA4 - page_view' with page_type. Before GTM version 9 the Google tag plus enhanced measurement's history events counted every ?bbox= map move as a page view and sent no page_type.
Enhanced measurement 'Page changes based on browser history events' stays off while the dataLayer owns page_view, or client-side navigations count twice.
The Google tag fires on Initialization - All Pages so its configuration is set before any event tag (GTM version 8).
Google Signals stays ON. Do not disable.
Event data retention at the Standard-tier maximum.

Nine key events. Matt removed four that nothing sent (schedule_showing, listing_showing_click, listing_inquiry, home_valuation_cta_click). A new key event needs a sender first and changes what Google Ads imports.
The primary channel group is 'AI Assistants (Custom)', so ChatGPT, Perplexity and similar referrals show as their own channel. Do not delete the group.
GA4 is linked to Google Ads customer 5881785778 so key events can be imported as Ads conversions from the link, never from an in-page AW- tag.
dwell carries the seconds threshold reached (event parameter 'seconds', GTM version 9), registered as the event-scoped custom dimension 'Dwell seconds' so time on page shows in reports.
generate_lead is sent once, from the server (Measurement Protocol). No browser tag sends it; a browser copy would double count every lead.
A known CRM contact is tagged in GA4 when they come back, with a hashed CRM id as user_id. Never a name, email or phone: GA4 forbids personal information. Who the person is lives in the CRM timeline.
Google Business Profile (Ryan Realty, 115 NW Oregon Ave Suite #2) is linked to the GA4 property.
decisions.manual: GA4 Admin > Product links > Google Business Profile links

decisions.why: Matt stays the only GTM administrator. GTM's 'add another administrator' recommendation is declined on purpose; do not raise it again.

decisions.why: The Google tag does not scan pages for emails, phones or names. On listing pages it would pick up the broker's own contact details.
decisions.manual: Google tag (GT-P3MG72KR) > Allow user-provided data capabilities > Automatically detect user-provided data: off

decisions.why: Configure your domains has one condition, contains ryan-realty.com, so the site's own subdomains are not outbound clicks or referrals. Never add the *.vercel.app deployment hosts Google suggests.

One plain-English admin dashboard (leads from the CRM, sources, what visitors look at, buyer vs seller intent, markets, Google search) replaces the scattered report pages, and the same view exists inside GA4 as a custom report collection.
